races.paceDynamic: Baggot Street and Spiced Gold will contest the early lead with Dinamine, Step Back In Time and Whatswrongnow sitting prominent behind them. This sets up a solid pace scenario where the front runners create enough tempo to benefit those racing handy without burning themselves out completely. The large field of 17 runners includes many hold-up horses who will need the early pace to fragment, but the two genuine pace-setters should ensure a fair gallop rather than crawling sectionals. This pace dynamic clearly favours prominent racers and those who can sit close to the speed without getting involved in the early battle.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Solid Pace Benefits Prominent
scenarios.trigger: If Baggot Street and Spiced Gold duel early while Dinamine and Step Back In Time track them closely.
scenarios.body: The front two set honest fractions that allow the prominent racers to strike turning for home when the leaders tire. Step Back In Time and Dinamine are perfectly positioned to capitalize with their tactical speed.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Baggot Street breaks cleanly and Spiced Gold fails to press him early enough.
scenarios.body: Baggot Street gets an easy lead and controls the race tempo, allowing him to find another gear when challenged. The lack of early pressure means he has plenty left for the finish while others struggle to make up ground.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Charge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too strong with Baggot Street and Spiced Gold going too fast.
scenarios.body: The front runners collapse in the final furlong after burning each other out, creating gaps for the hold-up horses to exploit. Wegotogether and Jazzit benefit from the strong pace and finish powerfully.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If both Baggot Street and Spiced Gold show reluctance to lead or go very slowly.
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace creates a sprint finish where tactical speed matters most and positioning becomes crucial. Dinamine's experience and Whatswrongnow's recent form help them respond to the lack of tempo.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Baggot Street breaks slowly as his front-running style needs early positioning to be effective
Monitor Spiced Gold early as he's been off 192 days and showed fading tendencies last season
Step Back In Time has strong recent form and the prominent style that suits this pace setup
Several runners including Bel Espoir and Bullet Bourbon have clear fading patterns that make them vulnerable
Dinamine's recent win and prominent style makes him a key pace player to follow

races.paceDynamic: Namiid stands out as the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the start without pressure. The prominent runners Reposado, Ennoble, Grande Cuvee and Cashel Blue will track close behind, while hold-up horses Keogie, Auguste Gusteau and Xerling face the challenge of making ground from off the pace. With Namiid likely to get an uncontested lead on good ground over this sharp 5f, the race shape strongly favours horses that can sit handy and capitalize on any weakening of the leader. This tactical setup gives prominent runners and those with tactical speed a clear advantage over pure hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Namiid gets an easy lead and maintains stamina reserves
scenarios.body: The pace-setter controls the race throughout and has enough left to repel challengers in the final furlong. His recent good form at this trip and lack of early pressure creates the perfect winning scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Takeover
scenarios.trigger: If the tracking horses time their challenge perfectly as Namiid weakens
scenarios.body: Reposado or Ennoble, positioned ideally behind the leader, strike at the right moment when the front runner's effort tells. Their class and tactical positioning proves decisive in a sustained finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is stronger than expected and the leaders come back
scenarios.body: Keogie and Auguste Gusteau benefit from a pace collapse, sweeping through tired horses in the final furlong. The ground and trip suit their finishing kick when others have gone too fast early.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Newcomer Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Trek Home or Allirelandmaterial show unexpected ability on debut
scenarios.body: One of the lightly raced runners possesses superior natural ability that overcomes inexperience. Their lack of race exposure becomes an advantage rather than hindrance in a weak maiden.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Namiid gets an uncontested lead as he becomes very difficult to peg back with his current form
Monitor how quickly Reposado and Ennoble position themselves behind the leader in the early stages
Check if either Trek Home or Allirelandmaterial show early pace that suggests hidden ability on debut
Observe whether the hold-up horses Keogie and Auguste Gusteau get the strong pace they need to be effective
Watch for any early struggles from long-absent Ennoble who hasn't been seen for over 200 days

races.paceDynamic: Eclairage and Lethimfly will break fast and engage early in a genuine speed battle over this sharp 5f trip. Both confirmed front-runners have the tactical speed to make this a searching gallop from flagfall, with Cuban Grey and Alfred Tennyson likely to press close behind in the early stages. The sustained pace will create a strong end-to-end gallop that will test stamina reserves in the final furlong. This honest pace scenario clearly favours prominent racers and hold-up horses with a strong finishing kick, while the two early leaders face the tactical challenge of surviving their own speed.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Dual Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If both Eclairage and Lethimfly engage in a prolonged speed battle through halfway
scenarios.body: The relentless early fractions will drain both leaders, creating a perfect setup for closers to sweep past in the final furlong. Hold-up horses like Midnight Dusk and Nouvel Espoir benefit most from this pace meltdown.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: One Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If either Eclairage or Lethimfly establishes a clear early advantage and dictates controlled fractions
scenarios.body: The surviving pace-setter avoids the speed duel and maintains enough energy to resist late challenges, especially with class advantage. Prominent racers struggle to bridge the gap without early pace pressure.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Victory
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuine but not suicidal, allowing prominent racers to stay within striking distance
scenarios.body: Cuban Grey or Howd'yadoit can track the leaders without excessive effort and time their challenge perfectly in the final 100 yards. The front two weaken just enough to be caught close home.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Holds Strong
scenarios.trigger: If Eclairage finds another gear when challenged and maintains his front-running supremacy
scenarios.body: The class horse proves his 204-day break has refreshed him completely, sustaining his early speed through to the line. His superior rating tells the story as others fade behind his relentless gallop.

watchPoints.text: Eclairage's fitness after 204 days off - if he's ring-rusty, the pace scenario changes completely as Lethimfly could get an easier lead.
Early positioning of Cuban Grey and Howd'yadoit - their ability to track without getting caught up in the pace battle determines their winning chances.
Midnight Dusk's breaking from the stalls - as a hold-up horse, he needs clean early passage to position for his late run.
Jockey tactics on Lethimfly - whether Dylan Browne McMonagle chooses to press Eclairage early or sits second could decide the race shape.
The ground conditions during the day - any changes from good ground could significantly impact the finishing speed of the hold-up horses.

races.paceDynamic: Limestone will dictate terms from the front in this small field, with no other confirmed pace-setters to pressure him early. The prominent runners Asakir, Sangreal, New Zealand and Trojan Fighter will track behind in the opening exchanges, while Star Of Tara settles last. Limestone's sustainable gallop will create a moderate tempo that should quicken from the 3f pole as the field compresses. This shape strongly favours horses with prominent tactical speed who can position close enough to strike when the pace lifts in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Limestone Leads Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Limestone maintains his unbeaten front-running record and the pace stays manageable
scenarios.body: His tactical advantage becomes decisive as Dylan Browne McMonagle can dictate when to inject pace, while the prominent pack may be positioned too far back when it matters. The honest gallop suits his stamina reserves perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pack Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent quartet can get close enough to Limestone turning for home
scenarios.body: New Zealand's class advantage or Trojan Fighter's sharp recent form could prove telling in a driving finish where positioning trumps pure ability. The moderate early pace allows them to conserve energy for the decisive move.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Limestone's gallop becomes too honest and the field comes back to him dramatically
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure staying test where New Zealand's Group class can shine through, with Asakir also benefiting from being held up closer than usual. Limestone pays for making the running throughout.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sangreal Spring Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the lightly-raced Sangreal improves significantly from his promising debut second
scenarios.body: Joseph O'Brien's second string could capitalise on race positioning and the 5lb weight advantage to outbattle more exposed rivals in a tactical finish. His fresher profile becomes the decisive edge.

watchPoints.text: Star Of Tara's 274-day absence and lowest rating make him vulnerable to being completely outclassed
New Zealand needs to show early tactical speed to avoid being positioned too far off the pace like recent runs
Limestone's front-running dominance could be threatened if any prominent horse decides to press him early
Asakir's 31-day gap and step up in trip create stamina doubts in the final furlong
Trojan Fighter's quick 8-day turnaround could provide either a fitness edge or leave him vulnerable late

races.paceDynamic: Madbadanddangerous will set a controlled pace from the front, with prominent runners Minella Rockett and Johnny Soda tracking within striking distance but unlikely to apply serious early pressure. The bulk of the field comprises hold-up horses (Manton Bay, Santa Bravado, Now Maybe, Fallacy) who will settle towards the rear and rely on staying power up the straight. With minimal pace pressure early, the tempo will be honest rather than demanding, setting up a finish where horses with tactical speed can strike. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and front-runners who can avoid a cavalry charge, while hold-up horses face the risk of a slowly-run race that reduces their closing kick advantage.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Madbadanddangerous maintains his lead without serious early pressure and kicks clear turning in
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows him to conserve energy for a decisive move, while hold-up horses struggle to close the gap from too far back. His recent good form and Ben Coen's tactical awareness make this the most likely outcome.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves too slow and the hold-up horses can unleash their finishing kicks
scenarios.body: Manton Bay and Now Maybe benefit from their superior finishing speed when the race becomes a sprint from the furlong pole. Their fresh recent form gives them the edge in a driving finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Johnny Soda or Minella Rockett can track the leader and quicken decisively in the straight
scenarios.body: The prominent position allows them to respond immediately to Madbadanddangerous while having enough left to hold off the closers. Johnny Soda's recent win and lighter weight make him the more likely beneficiary.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Madbadanddangerous goes too fast early or the race becomes a messy scramble
scenarios.body: The front-runner ties up badly and multiple hold-up horses converge simultaneously in a blanket finish. Santa Bravado's higher top speed rating could prove decisive in this scenario.

watchPoints.text: Minella Rockett's fitness after 176 days off - any signs of blowing or laboured movement suggests the layoff is telling
Early pace development - if Madbadanddangerous goes too fast or gets pressured by the prominent runners, it opens the door for closers
Johnny Soda's position tracking the leader - his recent win came from prominent position and similar tactics needed here
Hold-up horses getting cover in the early stages - Manton Bay and Now Maybe need to avoid being caught wide without cover
Ground conditions on the day - any ease in the going would favour the hold-up horses with higher top speed ratings
